notes:
Primary contact: Javier Morales (CTO) - strong emphasis on predictable latency during heavy support hours.

Key metrics & constraints:
- Indexing scale: target ingest 350k-500k docs (knowledge base + KB attachments).
- Query profile: high QPS bursts (baseline 400qps, peaks ~1000-1500qps, short tail).
- Latency target: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 <= 200ms end-to-end for query + rerank (hosted).
- Quality: current baseline recall acceptable but precision suffers; wants embedding + learned reranker to boost top-3 precision by ~15%.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost < $0.02/query after reranking savings (they value unit cost when scaling to millions/mo).

Current stack & migration notes:
- Prototype uses Pinecone for vector store, OpenAI embeddings, custom reranker in-house (approx 2-3x CPU cost).
- Docs stored in S3, metadata in Postgres. Looking to replace embedding provider + reranker with Redwood-hosted path if ROI works.

Security / compliance asks:
- Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 12+ months, EU data residency for EU customer subsets. KMS integration desirable.

Quotes & signals:
- Javier: "Need something we can trust at 10am PST when our support load spikes — not fluctuating cost per query or latency surprises."
- Ops: concerned about cold-cache behavior and autoscaling ramp times.

POC scope requested:
- 2-week hosted API POC: ingest 400k docs, replay 72 hours of traffic to emulate peaks, evaluate embedding variants, test reranker (1-pass vs 2-pass), measure per-query cost and p99 latency.
- Deliverables: cost projection spreadsheet, latency breakdown (tokenization, embed lookup, rerank), tuning knobs for batch sizes and caching.

Risks & notes to AE/SE:
- They currently pay Pinecone + large OpenAI bill; price delta must be clearly favorable or quality gains demonstrable.
- Legal cares about EU residency wording; coordinate with infra/compliance to scope Private option only if hosted can't meet residency SLA.

- Jordan -> share Redwood embedded cost model + sample tokenization for their doc mix (done 2026-03-02).
- Priya -> prepare POC runbook and required test data interface (expected 2026-03-12).
